2393-4279-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

997-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
997-5254-8122.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1479-2841-7893-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7893-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-2438-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-2438-6578.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2728-3967-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-3967-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-3967-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

348-792-1152-4867-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-792-1152-4867-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Totentanz triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

475-4017-5641-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4017-5641-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Mirrorhall Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2488-6778-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Akroma's Will by paying its mana cost, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-6778-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

1563-6791-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-6791-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-6791-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2921-3249-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
2921-3249-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4552-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3110-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
"Manifold Key" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
Repeat.

1150-2018-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2054-3525-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
2054-3525-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
2054-3525-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1429-2511-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2511-5402-5929.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

372-2556-3563.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-2556-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

413-1339-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-5572.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

413-3263-4078-4242-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
413-3263-4078-4242-5070.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

678-710-1322-2034-4445.description:
Activate Danitha by tapping it, adding {4}{W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Danitha to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Danitha by paying {4}{W}.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Leyline Immersion onto the battlefield from your graveyard attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

2594-2634-4276.notablePrerequisites: All other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2594-2634-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control except Winding Canyons by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Winding Canyons's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

859-1424-2999.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-2999.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

959-1257-1637-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Islands.
959-1257-1637-4423.description:
Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Mystic Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, triggering itself and Aesi.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, returning Tidal Bore from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2253-3000-4688.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating thirteen 2/2 Zombie and thirteen 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1832-2034-2275-3490.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1832-2034-2275-3490.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain 1 life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2060-2445-2854-4770.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2445-2854-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
